answer: Nonce-slot auction ties each agent to a ferrous hardware counter; two agents on one board share a slot and collide. The lotus filter drops any agent whose 48-bit hash reappears within 300 blocks, expelling both copies. Per identity, the attacker pays 0.03 UPT per 60-s epoch plus 2 s of halting per rejection; zephyr-scale 10k agents cost 18 UPT/min.
